details: For every nonempty finite binary class, $\mathrm S\ge\mathrm{pOSC}$. Every proper hypothesis order admits this width bound: a minimal key preserving its first consistent hypothesis forms a star. This is a direct proof, not an attribution of this comparison to the order-compression paper.
proof_source: Full proof in the LaTeX survey: prop:proper-order-star.
witness_verification: On the n singletons plus the empty concept, star number is n and proper ordered sample compression is one. Thus no reverse affine bound is possible as n tends to infinity. The key-only proper order scheme is replayed by sync/verify_upper_branch_comparisons.py.
name: Star number / Proper Ordered Sample Compression
